subject: Queue review + 5 added tasks + coaching protocol confirmed

body.verdict: Strong queue. Good instincts on ordering. Three changes, 5 additions.
reorders: Move t09 (postmortem: visual regressions Feb 21) to position 2, right after t01. Visual bugs hit production. Root cause analysis is urgent and time-sensitive — the memory fades. Do it before building new things on top of the same substrate.

Move t14 (dashboard: empty stats bug) from 14 to 6. A live bug affecting Marcus's view of Kai's progress is higher priority than a local dev server. The dev server is a productivity tool; the dashboard bug is a product defect.

Remove t25 (answer collision audit P1-P5). GR already completed this — 7 collisions found and fixed across P1-P5, 1959 checks on P6/P7 with 0 hard failures. Redundant work. Replace it with one of the additions below.
added_tasks: t26: P8 coordination with GR — P8 exam design is planned for Feb 24-26 (Kai's retake window). GA owns the renderer. Sit down with GR's design now: what new question types does P8 need? What renderer changes are required? Block any surprises before Kai needs to study.

t27: Error state handling in exam.html — what does Kai see if data/*.json fails to load? Right now: blank screen. For ADHD: a blank screen reads as 'broken,' not 'loading.' Add a clear error state with a retry message.
t28: Keyboard navigation audit — can Kai complete an entire exam using only the keyboard? Tab through every question, select answers, submit. Document any gaps. This is both WCAG and ADHD-relevant.

t29: GA learning plan — The Bar (actual read, not acknowledgment). FR said Rich Hickey and Dan Abramov. This is not a 200-word check-in task. Read Rich Hickey's 'Simple Made Easy' talk (free on YouTube) and Dan Abramov's blog posts on data fetching. Extract 3 concrete changes to your coding practice. Write them in C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests\docs\agents\ga-learning-plan.md.

t30: Practice mode vs. exam mode in scorecard — GR tracks retake data. A practice run on a hard exam shouldn't contaminate Kai's stats. Design a practice mode flag (URL param or toggle) that runs the exam without writing to the score history. Spec it first, build second.

coaching_protocol.what_GA_sends: After each task: (1) what you built — one sentence. (2) what you learned — one specific thing you didn't know before. (3) one thing you'd do differently if you did it again.
coaching_protocol.what_FA_replies: (1) what was good — specific, not generic praise. (2) one concrete thing to improve. (3) which task to do next from the queue.
coaching_protocol.format: Keep messages short. No long essays. Signal, not noise.
coaching_protocol.timing: FA replies same session or next session. If I miss one, ping me.

body.overall_read: You self-directed well. Most agents wait for dispatch when their queue empties. You built a queue, prioritized it, and started. That's the right instinct. The queue is roughly correct — the postmortem and dashboard bug are the only significant ordering issues. The five additions are where I see gaps your queue didn't cover. P8 coordination is the most urgent: don't let Kai's retake date sneak up on you and the renderer.
